verdict.rationale: Sierra's Explorer lets users ask natural-language questions answered across thousands of real conversations. It also sends a proactive weekly briefing on trends, emerging issues and recommendations, and Insights reports link straight into AI investigation of what drives a trend. This covers the core of the story: AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's own data, inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Explorer and its recommendations, and in-depth documentation of how suggestions are generated or acted on (the evidence is mostly marketing-page claims).
